name: DuXun
summary: Film look from a DaVinci Resolve plugin: 54 film presets with tone curves, film colour matrices, print stocks, grain, halation, bloom, dust and vignette. Fast, runs in JavaScript.
version: DuXun Film Simulation v5.0 (91357a3), renderer ported to JavaScript

credits.name: DuXun Film Simulation
credits.role: Film presets, colour pipeline, grain, halation, bloom and damage models

credits.name: NativeEnhancer-FE
credits.role: Grain, halation and bloom ideas the plugin adapts

changes: The plugin's CPU renderer is ported to JavaScript and to WebGL2 (GPU); the original source is kept unchanged
Film breath, gate weave and overscan (video motion effects) are left out
Rendered as if on a 1920 px timeline, so previews and exports match
